panchak.title: Panchak Patro {{year}}
panchak.subtitle: Panchak periods and muhurta details based on Vedic jyotish and Surya Siddhanta
panchak.intro: Panchak is the roughly five-day span while the Moon transits the last half of Dhanishta, Shatabhisha, Purva Bhadrapada, Uttara Bhadrapada, and Revati. Many traditions advise avoiding certain acts during Panchak, believing work done then may repeat fivefold.
panchak.no_data: Panchak details for B.S. {{year}} are not available yet.

prohibited.roof_desc: Placing the roof on a new house
prohibited.last_rites_desc: Performing cremation or final funeral rites

panchak.what_body: Panchak is the five-day lunar window through five special nakshatras (second half of Dhanishta through Revati). Travel south, gathering grass or firewood, and roofing a home are commonly avoided.
panchak.rahita_body: Scheduling auspicious rites (vivaha, mundana, etc.) in Panchaka-rahita windows keeps them outside these inauspicious spans so the work may proceed smoothly.

avakahada.title: Avakahada Chakra
avakahada.subtitle: 27 nakshatras, 108 charans — traditional table of name syllables, rashi, lord, varna, vashya, yoni, gana and nadi.
avakahada.abhijit_note: Abhijit — the intercalary 28th nakshatra formed by the last quarter of Uttara Ashadha and the first 15th of Shravana; name syllables: Ju, Je, Jo, Kha.
avakahada.wheel_subtitle: Outside to inside: nakshatra → name syllable (108 charans) → rashi → lord → varna → vashya → yoni → gana → nadi
avakahada.wheel_hub_hint: Tap a ring — nakshatra, syllable, rashi, varna, vashya, yoni, gana, nadi
avakahada.wheel_legend_rings: · 7 inner rings: rashi, lord, varna, vashya, yoni, gana, nadi
avakahada.bhoomadosha_note: Bhoomadosha (Mangal) is considered when bride and groom name-syllable groups are mutual enemies.
avakahada.footnote: Note: Mangal in lagna, 4th, 7th, 8th or 12th causes bhoomadosha; Saturn's aspect, Jupiter/Venus/Moon placement, kendragata Rahu etc. can cancel it (see shloka above).
